proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.areaOverride.relative_area_multiplier
proposed_widenings.justification: The item-granted Web cast modifies the referenced spell's existing area proportionally rather than replacing it with a concrete fixed shape.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "The web created by the spell fills twice its normal area."

notes: Authored as a composite magic item with passive worn benefits plus a once-per-dawn Web activation at fixed DC 13. The larger-area rider is omitted because the current surface lacks a relative granted-spell area override.
